requires: Actual root execution inside only owned private namespaces
scope: Detect-only IPv4/TCP biflow state and inspection; no neural-network or prevention claim
architecture_invariants: Canonical endpoint pair, protocol and interface context; namespace context is private map instance
TC ingress/egress is protected-host RX/TX, not dataset forward/backward
Unknown initiator without an observed initial SYN; no guessed direction label
Immutable generation identifiers prevent old-state expiration from deleting a replacement flow
Compound statistics/lifecycle updates serialize under the flow lock; helpers and tail calls outside the lock
A single observed FIN is half-close, not completed bidirectional shutdown
Closed and idle statistics really expire; canonical index storage remains explicitly bounded
No new owned BPF, qdisc, link or namespace remains after cleanup

predeclared_tolerances.packet_counts_and_bytes: Exact against independently captured/parsed observations at documented skb granularity
predeclared_tolerances.timing_arithmetic: Exact recomputation from exported actual kernel observation timestamps, not an independent wire-clock claim
predeclared_tolerances.clock_bounds: Kernel observations must fall within independently measured monotonic runtime bounds; no fabricated timestamps

required_scenarios: Actual bidirectional TCP handshake/data/shutdown uses one generation ID
Midstream trace without initial SYN remains explicitly unoriented
Variable IPv4 and TCP options parsed with validated header lengths
Truncated and inconsistent lengths skipped safely with counted reasons
VLAN, fragments, IPv6, unsupported protocols and nonlinear limits explicitly supported or counted as skipped
Duplicate/retransmitted observations follow a documented counting policy
FIN half-close remains separate from both-directions FIN/ACK completion
Tuple reuse gets a new generation; old cleanup cannot delete it
Independent concurrent connections preserve their own exact statistics
Repeated topology/controller lifetimes leave no unexpected growth or new object retention
Existing TC counter probe and foreign-resource ownership regressions remain valid after shared-loader changes
Actual read-only inspection returns coherent current flow snapshots
offload_limit: Do not claim wire-packet exactness or throughput/latency from veth/skb validation. GRO/GSO/TSO and nonlinear limitations must be recorded, not silently disabled or ignored.
failure_policy: Preserve failed raw results, correct only within Stage 04, and do not advance to Stage 05 until this gate passes. No suppressed checks or invented scores.
